name: kouro
description: A local workbench for declarative agent workflows

scripts.dev: bun run --cwd packages/web build && bun run packages/host/src/cli.ts serve
scripts.build:cli: bun run build && bun run scripts/build-cli.ts
scripts.release:forgejo: bun run typecheck && bun test packages/core packages/host && bun run build && bun run scripts/publish-forgejo.ts
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings packages scripts && bun run scripts/check-boundaries.ts
scripts.format: oxfmt --write packages scripts package.json tsconfig.json playwright.config.ts
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check packages scripts package.json tsconfig.json playwright.config.ts
